risk_note: Payment path, RV2, no money effect (the channels refuse a closed order anyway). BR-PAY-03, FU-PAY-IDEM-REPLAY-AFTER-CLOSE, D10-1067: a replayed POST /v1/pay/orders no longer returns its stored launch parameters once the order cannot be launched. On a replay of a stored success the controller calls replayRefusal: under the business object lock (the one taking parameters and closing use, spec-test r1 S1) it reads the caller's own order with the same test as a first create (PENDING, closing=false, before expire_at). Launchable: the stored bytes, unchanged. PAID: 30902 with data.pay_order_id. Anything else: 20902 with data.resource=pay_order. A failed read throws (50001) and never returns the stored bytes. idempotency_keys and pay_orders are not written: a byte-for-byte replay is not a new issue, launch_issued_at stays (D10-1102). The contract description gains one sentence; no schema change.

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh (D10-1075), effort medium, base the last test(spec) commit (couli-runs/B2-15y/money-review-r1.json). The round was output as fail with one S1: a launchable replay returns the launch parameters again without updating launch_issued_at, while BR-PAY-03 says every return records it and has no replay exception. Idempotency, concurrency, app_id and rounding were ok. Orchestrator ruling D10-1102 reclassified it as S2: the field only tells whether parameters were ever returned (BR-PAY-05 ①; pay-close.ts:151 only tests for null), a byte-for-byte replay gives the first answer again, and the first issue already wrote it; the orchestrator clarifies BR-PAY-03 in the next spec batch; [AC-B2-15y#4] stays and no r2 runs. So no S0 / S1 remains open by that ruling; the original verdict is recorded here.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests in 2 attempts by a fresh independent Claude. spec-test r1 (spec-test-review-r1.json, before D10-848 was voided) failed on 2 S1 + 1 S2: no test of the lock exclusion between a replay and a close, logs not asserted on the refused and launchable branches, launch_issued_at unpinned. The 2nd attempt added [AC-B2-15y#13], the log assertions and the whole-row pin in [AC-B2-15y#4]. r2 (spec-test-review-r2.json) passed with no S0 / S1.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
